## TL;DR

The full `repoos check` passed on source commit `c20ba664451d79b4e196c5815a9d37686b8223a3`. The macOS Hub QA record and XCTest registry-isolation fix are present. Signed-in Projects and Tasks remain unverified because human-assigned task #1174 has no results.

## Work and rationale

The QA record covers the Hub build and launch, first-run rendering, local server discovery and connection, and the sign-in page. Testing found the XCTest host could write to the developer's real Hub registry. The fix isolates XCTest in a unique temporary support directory, removes it on exit, surfaces cleanup errors, and tests those behaviors.

The QA record explicitly leaves logged-in Projects and Tasks unverified. Human task #1174 remains in inbox without results. No claim is made that this criterion passed.

## Approaches tried

Ran the full `repoos check` once against this tree. Remote build and test validation passed. Local formatting, lint, build, branch-artifact and task-asset checks passed; rendered contrast, UI smoke, landing and Telegram manager checks passed as well.

## Challenges and blockers

The signed-in acceptance check requires the human-assigned #1174 flow: sign in through the authorized email-code process, inspect Projects and Tasks, and record the tested build and results. That task has no results yet. The older review report citing source `2ac8b76` does not describe this checked source commit.

## Key learnings

Showing the sign-in page confirms connection and web-view rendering, not authenticated Projects or Tasks behavior. The report narrative must match the checked tree; RepoOS appends the generated change summary when finalizing the report.
